26743:
Drunken Tailor

Humboldt's Haberdashery, or as everyone calls it, the Drunken Tailor, is a fabric and clothing shop located not in a building, but in a wheelbarrow that its owner, Efram Humboldt, carries through the city streets. The clothes he creates are extraordinary, possessing different magical properties to suit each customer's taste.⁠
640743:
Glacier's Rest

Glacier's Rest is a small town in the foothills of the Stormspear Mountains of northwestern Hagreach in the Lands of the Linnorm Kings. It is five miles south of a long-abandoned dwarven fortress, which as of 4724 AR had been claimed by General Ordulf Bladecaller and named Crownhold.⁠
6368603:
Gray Falls Lodge

Just west of the Embeth Forest, a gray and weather-worn gristmill leans wearily over a trickling stream that slowly feeds into one of the dozens of winding tributaries of the Sellen River. The gristmill belongs to Sayrin Firewyne, a gnome with a romanticized interest in her fey roots who specializes in the lost knowledge of the First World.⁠⁠

The Gristmill serves as the front for the unlikely venture-captain's Pathfinder lodge, called the Gray Falls Lodge. It also serves as a sanctuary for a handful of local fey, in addition to being the permanent residence of a small band of pixies who nest in the rafters, and a nixie who resides in the stream.⁠⁠

The Gristmill contains an observatory and is powered by a secret magical contraption that resides behind a waterfall near the cottage.⁠⁠
24736953:
Adhaarm

Adhaarm is a small village that surrounds a monastery on the south-western edge of the Narhari Desert in Vudra.⁠⁠ Its sole purpose is to feed the never-ending hunger of the great devourer Rudrakavala who dwells nearby.⁠

35042973:
Treaclerun

The estate of Treaclerun is home to the ruler of Kazuhn Prefecture, the Grand Duchess Mellea Denzarni, and is named for the decadent parties her ancestors used to throw there: parties where fountains of honey flowed like water. While appearing as little more than a hedonistic hunting lodge to escape from the strife of Taldan politics, in reality, Treaclerun has a bloody history. Serving as the breadbasket of Taldor's capital, Oppara, rulership of Kazuhn has generally fallen to only the most ruthless of Taldor's power players. The estate serves as a discrete location for shady deeds and sinister schemes. Almost every noble estate in Taldor boasts a handful of ghost stories associated with it, Treaclerun is a rare exception: no lingering spectres haunt its ground. Rumour has it this is due to some strange but deliberate quirk of the estate's design.⁠
43557203:
Matriculum's Charge

Matriculum's Charge, formally known as Hillsprung, gets its name from the dragon that guards it, Matriculum.⁠
57057593:
Mount Keeba

Mount Keeba is the largest active volcano in the Shackles and is known in the archipelago as "the Smoker". It is located on the volcanic isle of the Smoker. Slow but steady rivers of lava course down the mountain's northern slope, and steam hisses violently as the molten material strikes the ocean waters. A steady plume of smoke rises from the huge crater at the volcano's summit. The volcano lends its name to a trio of seers called Keeba's Eyes, access to whom can be difficult and long in waiting.⁠⁠
63681103:
Vanderale Villa

Vanderale Villa is the home of Magnimar's House Vanderale, one of the city's oldest families.⁠
63799423:
Lethe Springs

Lethe Springs is a magical hot spring located high in the Southern Zho Moutnains of Qadira in sight of the mountains Zhonar and Zhobl. While the springs seem like the perfect place to relax and warm oneself from the chill mountain air, its waters carry a terrible curse: drinking the waters obliterates one's memories and transforms the body into a fiendish mockery of oneself.⁠
65658453:
Ostergarde Manor

Ostergarde Manor is located in the northwest of Cheliax, near the Menador Gap. Although easily accessible by road, no one dares visit the manor due to rumors that it is haunted. House Kastner lived here, acquiring diabolical lore even before the rise of House Thrune. The Kastners abandoned the manor and moved to Egorian when they no longer needed to conceal their research and devil-binding. The estate passed to the Blakros family in 4712 AR after Damian Kastner married Michellia Blakros.⁠
71828073:
Cathedral of Embodied Wisdom

The Cathedral of Embodied Wisdom is a magnificent obsidian-colored bone building dedicated to the use and care of the memory chains. The shelves inside are made of skulls linked by chains, demonstrating the building's purpose: to hold and respect the individual pain and agony of all who use the cathedral. Lovers of pain gather here, introducing new experiences to the memory chains, a process that, due to their antiquity, is both arduous and creative. The chains not only contain experiences of pain but also absorb lore and knowledge from those they interact with, and it is this knowledge that attracts scholars and historians from across the Inner Sea region.⁠
81653173:
Nagura

Nagura is a small town in southern Minkai important as a trading post at the crossroads of three important highways.⁠
91741613:
Devils' Garden

Devil's Garden, also known as Cheliax's Garden, is a neighborhood in the Foreign Quarter where both exiles from the nation and agents of House Thrune live together, enjoying wine, opera, and the company of each other most of which cannot return to their homeland. After the civil war, many nobles went to Absalom to escape persecution, although several were killed by the new regime, which did not provoke a strong response from Absalom beyond a letter of disapproval to their embassy. Tensions have eased in recent decades, and as long as these nobles do not act against Her Majestrix, they have nothing to fear. Throughout the district, hatred and detestance toward Ravounel can be observed.⁠
106187553:
Mount Osiki

Mount Osiki is the tallest mountain within the range of Brazen Peaks in northern Garund,⁠ east of the Pahmet settlement of Erekrus.⁠ Its foothills and smaller peaks extend almost to the Crook River.⁠

An ancient stairway begins from a stone landing on the southern bank of the Crook, winding through the foothills and the peaks to end at the top of the mountain. Upon the peak is an ancient shrine to a forgotten deity, and the few people that climb the ancient stairway each year are rumored to have committed to the pilgrimage after being saved from death or ruin by a dark-cloaked stranger. Nothing is known about what happens at the shrine, as the pilgrims returning from the top of Mount Osiki do not talk about it under any inducement.⁠
125402193:
Succoring Muse

The Succoring Muse is a drug den and flop house in Kaer Maga's Oriat district, run by the Sczarni Parfus Erigol. It offers a wide assortment of recreational drugs, and a place to use them out of the public eye. To this end, Erigol offers a range of price options for short-term stays, ranging from extravagant and luxurious accommodations, catering to the client's every need, to dingy floprooms for those on the lower end of the economic spectrum. Erigol's larger-than-life persona and reasonable prices make him a favorite of local students and artists looking for a short escape from their troubles. Young women are generally advised not to visit the Succoring Muse by themselves, as the owner is not above renting out his customers by the hour while they are incapacitated by his narcotic fare.⁠

141676943:
Pig

The Pig is a run-down tavern in the working-class Rag's End neighborhood of Magnimar's Beacon's Point district. A former slaughterhouse, the building housing the Pig had been condemned for years before being converted into a drinking establishment. Even though the wind whistles through its many holes and leaks, it has never been able to completely rid itself of its abattoir smell.

The Pig is patronized mostly by butchers who work nearby and who are used to the smell. It serves few drinks and even less food, but is known for brineskin curls, a pickled pig-skin dish soaked in brine and blood, that can turn the stomach of even the most veteran butcher.⁠⁠
144265323:
Chastel

Chastel is the largest town in the Ustalavic county of Lozeri, lying on that county's southern border. The town is located close to the southern edge of the Shudderwood just north of the meeting point of the Vhatsuntide River with its tributary, the Vistear River.⁠⁠⁠ Chastel has the air of a frontier settlement despite its size, possibly due to the roughness exhibited by the locals. The town, though, does have a large market, lumber mills, and stockyards⁠ but lacks any protective walls, and as such, it is often the target of predators, the most notorious being the Rats of Karneik.⁠ In 4701 AR, Chastel was invaded by the murderous winter wolf known as the Devil in Gray; in a single night, he killed nearly twenty people before disappearing back into the wilds of Lozeri.⁠
154892043:
Kirahata

Kirahata (pronounced kee-RAH-hah-tah)⁠ is a hedonistic city located in southeastern Chu Ye that is popular with tourists. Talented humans travel to Kirahata to purse stardom, though mistakes in the oni-ruled land can become deadly. Kirahata's governor is Tamami, an oni with the wealth to challenge Chu Ye's ruler Tsuneni but prefers the novelty of meeting her city's newcomers over the responsibilities of rulership.⁠
156343493:
Round Mountain

Round Mountain is an earthen sphere 10 miles in diameter⁠ that was dropped onto western Po Li in 7219 IC. It was formerly part of the Hao Jin Tapestry, where it was transported centuries ago from the Darklands of Tian Xia by Hao Jin to halt an invasion of the region by the ratfolk of Diguo-Dashu.⁠
165316873:
Cauldheart

Cauldheart is a pit-like valley of grey stone in the Amaans peaks of the Hungry Mountains, between Mount Aremetrus and Gristleknob in the nation of Ustalav. It stretches over three miles in the shape of a human liver, and is so steep that no path leads to its depths; it is not considered scalable, and only ivy escapes from the pit.

This dark location generates rumours, including the use of Cauldheart as a gigantic witches' cauldron used by covens to perform all manner of evil: summoning foul weather and evil gods, crafting slave abominations, and corrupting the land.⁠⁠
184486763:
Bent Rib Alley

Bent Rib Alley is a small street that ends in a cul-de-sac in a poor part of Magnimar's Keystone district.⁠⁠
194517083:
Ludovny

Ludovny is a small town north of the Hoarwood Forest in the Irriseni province of Hoarwood. The town has been the main supplier of Hoarwood's provincial capital for centuries and has managed to maintain its position using political machinations and a river of bribes.

Countess Natalka Aelena uses any means necessary to preserve Ludovny's lucrative trade status. Her two sons, Laszlo and Ludvak pull the strings of the Bitter Brotherhood, the gang of bandits who plague the trade routes from Lod and Dammartorp to Hoarwood. The countess's youngest daughter, Bozidara is also involved in Natalka's diplomatic efforts. Bozidara lives in Hoarwood, attending the endless parties of the Duchess Anelisha, whispering poisoned words and slipping bribes into the hands of key officials and merchants.

The town itself welcomes the merchant visitors with cosy inns, rousing taverns, two extravagant brothels, and a busy theater called the Brenezoi which hosts performers from the southern lands of the Inner Sea.⁠
200605993:
Weeping Fields

The Weeping Fields were once a plain with a verdant meadow, but after Earthfall, shadows filled the area and drained the vegetation of its color. It was here that the Black Triune met with Zon-Kuthon and signed the agreement that sealed the fate of all Nidal. Now, the Weeping Fields form the entry point to the Umbral Basin.⁠

There are some vestiges of civilization on the plain, but shadowy predators and the soil that hinders agriculture make life difficult for the few who choose to live there. The Nidalese army, the Adamant Guard, makes more use of the plain, conducting military exercises and training recruits. At the end of their training, and after a grueling trial, successful recruits are able to join the Adamant Guard, where they earn the respect and fear of the rest of Nidal's inhabitants.⁠

229205413:
Fort Fang

Fort Fang has been the headquarters of its region's kholo for decades. This fortress is built on top of Ancient Osirian ruins and was founded by the kholo slaver Hlasho. It houses around 500 soldiers and slavers and 1,500 slaves at any given time.

The fort is the target of frequent attacks by the Eagle Knights of Andoran as part of their abolitionist activities.⁠

The status of this fortress is unknown since the widespread abolition of slavery in the Inner Sea region since 4719 AR.
230233423:
Bronze House

The ornate Bronze House is the regional headquarters for the international corporation known as the Aspis Consortium in the Varisian city of Magnimar. Located in the city's working-class Dockway district, it was established in the early years after Magnimar's founding by the Aspis Consortium's executive board in the Chelaxian city of Ostenso, in the hopes of looting many of the ancient Thassilonian ruins that dot the Varisian landscape.⁠ The house's executive director is Gold Agent Maiveer Sloan.⁠
235504273:
Stom's Claim

Stom's Claim is a ramshackle silver mining camp deep in the Menador Mountains between Cheliax and Nidal.⁠
239803343:
Wolf's Ear

The town of Wolf's Ear is located in western Varisia where the Lampblack River empties into Ember Lake. It gains its name from the unusually large population of lycanthropes who once called the community home.⁠⁠
248205233:
Ascanor Lodge

Ascanor Lodge is a private hunting compound for wealthy individuals located in the Shudderwood of the Ustalavic province of Lozeri.⁠

Kaddren Villa

Kaddren Villa is the stately city villa of the Kaddren family, and is located in the northernmost corner of Magnimar's Alabaster District next to Nirodin Villa.⁠
253931233:
Street of Little Gods

The Street of Little Gods is located in the Tarheel Promenade district, where deities without large congregations have small altars dedicated to them. From minor northern gods like Demon Lords, to the faith of Razmir or the Prophecies of Kalistrade, all have a place to pray and pay homage to their faith, seeking new followers.⁠
264228273:
Akhenaten

Little is known about the ruins of Akhenaten in eastern Thuvia near its border with Osirion. The ruins are located close to the junction of the Junira and the Scarab Rivers.⁠ On the Osirian side of the Junira are the ruins of el-Amara.⁠
268047863:
Cahshil

Cahshil is a hamlet built upon a particularly deep wetland in southern Sargava by a community of Song'o halflings originally from the Laughing Jungle who fled the escalating warfare between the lizardfolk and boggards. These halflings are subsistence hunters and rarely trust or interact with outsiders, giving rise to the erroneous rumours that they command terrible spirits and eat human flesh.⁠ The tojanida Guughwa is an occasional ally and frequent bully of Cahshil's residents, and often demands hospitality and attention from them.⁠

The state of Cahshil is unknown since the Vidric Revolution removed Sargava's government.
268608453:
Natatorium

The natatorium of Nal-Kashel, an island in the Hellmouth Gulf west of Cheliax off the shore of Blackcove, was a stepped public pool once used by the island's Azlanti inhabitants during the era of ancient Azlant. Like the rest of the abandoned island, it is now in ruins.⁠
273721683:
Lepidstadt

Founded in 3898 AR,⁠ Lepidstadt is the largest settlement in Ustalav's county of Vieland and effectively acts as the county's capital since the governing council is based there.⁠⁠ Lepidstadt is located on the banks of one of Ustalav's numerous rivers,⁠ west of the foothills of the enormous and near-impassible Tusk Mountains that mark the border with the Hold of Belkzen.⁠
275361073:
Kho

The ruins of Kho were once the first flying city of the Shory Empire.⁠⁠ Located in the Kho-Rarne Pass of the Barrier Wall Mountains between the Mwangi Expanse and Osirion, the former Shory capital fell to earth millennia ago.⁠
286291533:
Winterbreak

The city of Winterbreak is located on Acuben Isle in Brevoy on the Lake of Mists and Veils. The city is controlled by House Lodovka . To the city's south-east is located Winterbreak Bay.⁠
288925193:
Everrest

Everrest is the ruins of a Chelaxian manor house built in the Nesmian Plains of Nirmathas by House Arvanxi before Cheliax lost its claim to Molthune and Nirmathas. Abandoned by House Arvanxi since the Chelaxian Civil War, the current occupants of the ruins are exiles of the Thornscar orc tribe, led by Krov Thirdmother, a fanatical follower of Lamashtu.⁠
289308533:
Egorian

Egorian (pronounced eh-GOR-ee-an)⁠ became the capital of Cheliax upon the Thrune Ascendancy in 4640 AR, replacing the city of Westcrown. House Thrune wished to create a new imperial capital to honor its new allegiances far from the nobles and history of Westcrown.⁠ It is also known as the City of Thorns.⁠
296356603:
Fish Bowl

The Fish Bowl is a riverside temple to Besmara in the city of Riddleport.⁠⁠⁠

This bowl-shaped structure sits atop a stone base, assessable via a staircase cut into the stone construction. The large bowl is filled with seawater and contains several variety of aquatic predators, such as swamp barracudas, bunyips, and reefclaws.⁠ These beasts are kept under close guard, however, as the clergy is well aware of the harm such creatures can inflict if let loose in the city.⁠

Although the priests are secretive about their activities, they occasionally use the aquatic predators for grisly sacrificial rites in worship of Besmara. These rites are not without dangers, and even the priests have fallen prey to the beasts.⁠

Most of Riddleport's seafaring inhabitants visit the temple, at least occasionally, to donate funds and request favors from the Pirate Queen. These visitors are rarely known for their piety or dedication, making their patronage unpredictable at best.

The head of the temple is Ruben Carfay.⁠
303179943:
Coralesian

The small town of Coralesian sits high in the northeastern Five Kings Mountains, and even though it is considered to be within the territory of the dwarves, it has been settled by mostly elves from neighboring Kyonin, who live here among the snowcapped peaks and pine trees of the mountains. Some live in small huts in the high alpine meadows, while others have built cliff-dwellings connected by ladders, bridges, and tunnels. No matter where they make their home, however, they all band together to support each other through the long, cold mountain winters.⁠
320756123:
To Eat the World

To Eat the World is a famous restaurant in Westgate thanks to its chef, Sammael Rantore, who transforms the process of cooking and serving food into a dramatic spectacle that people even pay to watch. Only the wealthiest and most noble can afford to book a dinner here, which can take weeks or months, but the price is commensurate with the work and entertainment provided. Adventurers are hired to obtain the specific ingredients desired by their clients, and mementos of the most outlandish culinary feats adorn the walls. On one of the tables are statues of the Rantore family eating a cake shaped like Golarion.⁠
329076263:
Mantarin

Mantarin was built in the southern Rimethirst Mountains⁠ during the First Mendevian Crusade as a penal colony, but after Drezen fell, all contact with Mendev ceased. After realizing the gravity of their situation, the commanders offered all of the prisoners freedom as long as they swore oaths to join the crusade and fight against the demons of the Worldwound in an effort to make it back to Mendev, but all were killed before completing half of the journey.⁠

As of 4711 AR, the penal colony was populated entirely by half-fiends serving their demon masters.⁠ It is unknown what state the fortress and its population are in after the closing of the Worldwound.

Kerim

Kerim is one of the numerous large, prosperous cities that dot the fertile Qadiran region of Pashman. It is located some miles east of the banks of the Pashman River. The river is Pashman's south-western border with the neighbouring region of Tapur.⁠⁠

382678823:
Irespan

The Irespan, sometimes called the Giant's Bridge, is the largest and most impressive monument in all of Magnimar and overshadows the city's poorest district known as Underbridge. The Irespan is actually the remains of an enormous bridge that stretches into the Varisian Gulf, standing over 300 feet above the sea and over 100 feet wide. It is, like most of the monuments that dot the Varisian landscape, a remnant of ancient Thassilon.⁠⁠
391315603:
Red Rune Canyon

Red Rune Canyon, located in the eastern Tusk Mountains of the Realm of the Mammoth Lords, is an interconnected maze of canyons tainted by the relentless expansion of the Worldwound. Festering black boils and sores weep red bloodlike mud from its walls. The canyons change form under the demonic influence, with blasphemous runes etched into Golarion's surface. The evil of Red Rune Canyon drives any living creature who enters it mad.⁠

Larisa, a cambion sorcerer, arrived to Red Rune Canyon in 4713 AR. Using blasphemous sacrifices at each new moon, she gained control of the glyphs inscribed by the canyon. Each sacrifice calls forth a new symbol and siphons power from the distant Worldwound. When she bends the canyon into her grand final rune, she will get rid of her mortal blood and metamorphose into a full demon.⁠

The reshaping of the Red Rune Canyon has weakened the barriers between Golarion and the Outer Rifts. At each of Larisa's rituals, a new gate is forced open for a few seconds, oozing demons out into the Tusk Mountains.⁠

393778873:
Indapatta

Indapatta is the breathtakingly beautiful capital of the Impossible Kingdoms of Vudra that was founded by the first Maharajah Khiben-Sald.⁠ The city is located within the Golden Basin region of Vudra on the north-eastern banks of Sona Lake.⁠⁠
399406503:
Hook Ford

The Pale River may not be particularly wide but it is for most of its length deep, with Hook Ford one of the few places where it can be forded. Hook Ford is a vital asset to the nearby town of Bronze Hook which once grew rich of the toll charged to cross the river. As land based trade across the Uwaga Highlands trade route became less common, Hook Ford became less and less important. Now, the only reminder of its former importance is a watchtower manned by a single guard. The only other notable feature is the pride of dragonnes that live in the nearby hills that the lone guard keeps placated with offerings of meat.⁠
409961603:
Vannisaria

Vannisaria is one of the many cities of the Tian Xia nation of Linvarre, which was formerly the Taldan colony of Amanandar. Vannisaria was founded by Brutus Vannisar and has since been home to multiple generations of the Vannisar family, including General Jiayi Vannisar, Brutus's great-granddaughter and Linvarre's leader as of 4724 AR. The city is also host to the Temple of the Eternal and Exquisite Rose, the largest temple to Shelyn on the continent.⁠
413045933:
Trezira

Trezira is a small town on the Frozen Road River in the eastern part of Irrisen's Bleakmarch province. It single distinguishing feature is that it was granted a monopoly on "ice cleaving" (the process of keeping a river navigable year-round) the Frozen Road in 4623 AR by Queen Elvanna. Nearly a hundred years later, fur-wrapped citizens of Trezira still patrol the river in their "breaker barges", using any means at their disposal to maintain a navigable channel through the ice.⁠

The ruler of the town is Baroness Marcia who is not very oppressive of the peasants provided they do whatever is necessary to fulfill their obligations and especially do nothing to endanger the "ice cleaving" monopoly. Most successful of the seven "ice cleaving" companies is the White Stewards led by Trepek Gorny. Trezira is also the main trading partner of the frost giant hold of Holvirgang. The frost giant guests in town usually prefer the Horned Helm Inn run by the Ulfen Ludmil Arronsson, a giant of a man himself.⁠
425798263:
Godsgate

The Godsgate is the largest gate in the outer walls of the Andoren capital of Almas. It is also the easternmost gate, and from here visitors can easily access the East Hill, Portside, and Liberty District. Ever since the People's Revolt of 4669 AR brought democracy to the nation, the doors of the Godsgate have never been closed, a source of great pride for the people of Almas.⁠⁠
427026543:
Misarias

The city of Misarias in northeastern Cheliax stands on the banks of the River Keld on the Isgeri border, and serves as a waypoint for travelers of all sorts—thieves to diplomats, and brigands to scouts.⁠ With a suspicious eye on Andoran and Molthune, and with memories of the Goblinblood Wars ever in mind, Her Infernal Majestrix's generals keep most of the nation's massive army stationed in the region, where they could hold back an invasion ere reinforcements could come across the Fields of Chelam or the Sirmium Plains to aid them.⁠ Despite the large military presence, rumors hold that agents of the Molthune Armsrunners, a mercenary group operating out of Logas in Isger, keep rooms in Misarias where the organization is recruiting guards, customers, and scouts within Cheliax's borders.⁠
438696873:
Castle Kintargo

Castle Kintargo is an impressive and imposing structure that dominates the Castle District of Kintargo. Its vaunted impregnability has not been truly tested in centuries. Castle Kintargo also encloses the sealed and once notorious prison Kintargo Keep, its spires rising five stories high to the northwest of the main castle.⁠
448411713:
District Courthouse

The District Courthouse in The Coins is located in the western part of the district, just outside the Grand Bazaar. It is in this building that district justice should be administered, but although several corrupt judges have been removed in recent years, there are always people willing to reduce sentences or declare innocent those whose wallets weigh more heavily on them.⁠
458103423:
Seinaru Heikiko

Seinaru Heikiko is a fortress built five centuries ago by order of the Emperor of Minkai, who commanded one of his daimyo to crush a nobleman's rebellion in the Osogen Grasslands. The daimyo's armies constructed this fortress, filling its armory with weapons blessed by Shizuru and for three years, it was used in a military campaign against the northern barbarians. Over the decades, it was abandoned and various groups have taken control of the fortress over the years, bandits being the most common.⁠
474079953:
House of the Beast

The House of the Beast is one of the most legendary temples dedicated to Rovagug in Katapesh. It is located on the barren slopes of the Pale Mountain in the Brazen Peaks. It is said that the temple had been built by a mysterious fire spirit who rose from the molten heart of the mountain.⁠

As of 4709 AR it had become the lair of Ghartok, the Carrion King, warlord of the region's kholo tribes.⁠
479691133:
Eastern Lighthouse

The Eastern Lighthouse is one of the most enduring structures in Devil's Elbow, having been built through the efforts of Yaris Neraken and being the spot from which the poor man jumped to his death. Even after decades of neglect, the exterior of this 40-foot-tall tower remains, covered in grime, yes, but still standing.⁠

The Vale of Shadows is a dangerous valley located in the Five Kings Mountains, in which one of Zon-Kuthon's Star Towers is located. Here the planar fabric between the Netherworld and Golarion is weak, and the Vale all but appears to be within the Netherworld itself, and creatures and monsters from that plane live within.⁠ The elves of Elistia forbid entrance to the Vale of Shadows, believing nothing good comes from it and knowing few who venture inside return alive.⁠
527404933:
College of Dimensional Studies

One of the many magical fraternities that make their home in the city of Katapesh, the College of Dimensional Studies specializes in magic relating to interdimensional travel or visiting truly distant parts of the Universe. The domed building of the college is located in the crowded Inner City district of Katapesh and contains not only the normal dormitories and laboratories expected of a wizards' college, but also a huge telescope open even for the general public's use on some nights.⁠ The College of Dimensional Studies is also, therefore, one of the foremost schools of astronomy in the Inner Sea region.⁠

One of the most unique features of the college is its lack of doors. All students are expected to possess an array of travel magic and are expected to be able to teleport between rooms. Students of the college are also expected to create scrolls of transport magic as part of their payment for the college's unique education.⁠ The College of Dimensional Studies is also one of the few institutions on Golarion to house one of the rare and mysterious astralabes, devices of enormous utility to those seeking to explore the planes of the Great Beyond.⁠

Home of the noted Pathfinders Canayven Heidmarch and Venture-Captain Sheila Heidmarch, Heidmarch Manor is the first Pathfinder lodge in all Varisia, serving as the Pathfinder Society's base of operations into the rest of Varisia. 545534663:
Truther & Trathis Mining and Excavation Company

A nondescript building in the city of Katapesh serves as the office of Truther & Trathis Mining and Excavation Company, a mining and excavation enterprise maintained by two dwarves, Gravlet Truther and Kip Trathis. The pair are notoriously spendthrift with their money and refuse to pay anyone else to do work that they can't do themselves.

The company usually has a variety of operations in process at any given time, and are working on reopening the Zolurket Mines despite the rumors of undead there, and excavating the region around the Crouching Jackal. They claim to have come across an ancient scroll depicting other structures around the statue, and think that their excavation efforts will reveal other lost structures buried beneath the sand.

The truth behind the Zolurket Mines operation is that it is, in fact, haunted by the two dwarves' dead business partner, Tibbler Rocksledge, abandoned decades ago to a mummy attack when the trio was first exploring the mines. The ghost of Tibbler haunts the mines in anticipation of the return of Truther and Trathis, who have returned several times searching for rich platinum deposits buried there.

The current mining operation is their most ambitious to date: they've employed diggers to tunnel through the rock around their ghostly foe, but the work goes slowly and the two dwarves are growing increasingly frustrated. They are ready to hire a group of specialize ghost hunters to take out Tibbler permanently, despite the extra costs and hassle involved in employing adventurers. What they haven't realized is that the only way to permanently destroy the ghost is to satisfy its need to bring the pair to justice.⁠

Gloaming Wood

The Gloaming Wood is a small and light evergreen woodland in the Nesmian Plains of Nirmathas, west of the Inkwater River. 600930173:
Cassomir

Cassomir is located at the mouth of the Sellen River, and is the second largest settlement in the empire of Taldor. It acts as a major trade city, and through its ports enter goods from the Inner Sea, as well as from nations to the north that utilize the Sellen as a trade route. Cassomir is also home to the greatest of Taldor's imperial shipyards, even though the majority of the fleet itself is stationed in Oppara.⁠⁠⁠

Delvehaven is the Pathfinder lodge in the old Chelaxian capital of Westcrown. It was founded in the late 47th century AR by Venture-Captain Aiger Ghaelfin.⁠

City Mortuary

The City Mortuary in Lubbertown is next to the Burying Ground on the outskirts of town. It is a chapel jointly run by the churches of Cayden Cailean, Calistria, and Besmara. Those who can afford it are buried in niches within the building.⁠
619578783:
Fifth Wind

The Fifth Wind is a stone weather vane that rises from the Dockway district in Magnimar. The sides feature carvings of air elementals and cloud dragons. All of Outcast's Cove can determine the speed and direction by looking up at the windsocks. Those who spend time observing this monument are rumored to avoid seasickness.⁠
623398603:
Riddleport

Riddleport is the third-largest city in Varisia and its northernmost port. The city is a haven for pirates and sea-faring brigands, who find themselves far to the north of the Arch of Aroden. Teeming with criminals and rogues of all kinds, Riddleport is full of potential danger and hard-to-avoid intrigue. Also known as the City of Cyphers, Riddleport takes its name from the Cyphergate, a giant stone arch spanning the natural cove around which the city is built. It is covered on both sides with ancient Thassilonian symbols, although their exact meaning is unknown.⁠
630527363:
Katapesh

Sprawling across a valley of blazing-hot sand, is one of the most incredible and wondrous cities in all of Golarion: the great desert metropolis of Katapesh (pronounced KAT-a-pesh), the City of Trade.⁠⁠ Katapesh is a city of organized chaos where cash is king and commerce is the highest god.⁠

From its early beginnings as the Golden City, Katapesh was rich in natural resources and is located on the shores of the Obari Ocean. It retained its mercantile importance no matter who occupied the city.⁠

The metropolis of Katapesh is the home to many bazaars and fairs that sell anything one might desire. Two notable permanent markets within the city are the Peculiar Emporium and the Nightstalls.⁠
634447363:
Lightning's Call

Lightning's Call, also known as Lightning Top,⁠ is a mountain of the Five Kings Range located at the border of the Five Kings Mountains and Kyonin in central Avistan. It bears one of the Carved Kings sculptures featuring the visage of King Harral,⁠⁠ which overlooks the southern side of the Great Pass.⁠

The mountain derives its moniker from the perpetual gathering of storm clouds around its peak,⁠⁠ a weather phenomenon that wizards of Tar-Kazmukh have determined is not magical in nature but remain mystified by.⁠
641995753:
Pyre

The Pyre is a headland which extends into the Varisian Gulf just southwest of Sandpoint. Before Sandpoint was settled, Varisians used this area for rituals, including the Swallowtail Festival.⁠
646830833:
Cavlinor

Cavlinor is an elven outpost in Nirmathas, located on the southern bank of the Deepcut River where it joins the Marideth River. A few dozen mostly transient elves live in this settlement, which resembles a hunting lodge more than an actual town. The elves are mostly concerned with exploring elven ruins in the area and making diplomatic contact with the fey of the Fangwood. Sivron Nal, Cavlinor's manager, was an outspoken advocate for aiuvarins in Kyonin, and their appointment here—far from the other elves—might be construed as exile.⁠

Scrawny Crossing

The abandoned hamlet of Scrawny Crossing is in the western River Kingdoms. It served as a ferry crossing and caravan stop until 4706 AR, when its inhabitants disappeared in mysterious circumstances.

Unbeknownst to the folk of the region, Scrawny Crossing now serves as a base for a band of aquatic slavers—scrag/ulat-kini cross-breeds. These monsters capture humanoids for use in strange experiments. Their leaders are a naga ("Lord Slissk"), a scrag sorcerer ("Thult-Lorth") and a sea hag ("Mother Slug"), although they in turn take their orders from a telepathic creature that might be an alghollthu master.⁠

Stranger still, next to the ruins of Scrawny Crossing's old smith sits an oddity known as the Boiling Well, a well whose water always came out at body temperature. Unbeknownst to anyone living there, this was because the well harboured a secret soulgate that linked to the Infernal Duke Eaqueo's domain of the Finishing Knot on Hell's first layer, Avernus.⁠

Darkreach

The settlement of Darkreach was established on the Vanji River around 30 years ago. It was intended to serve as a trading post between the mines of the Bandu Hills and the markets of Bloodcove in the Mwangi Expanse and of western Sargava.

At first it thrived—only to be razed to the ground by forces unknown. The people vanished, and all that was left of the buildings was the charred outline of the foundations. No natural fire cuts buildings off smoothly at ground level, and leaves no ash behind.

Some suspect the Aspis Consortium of wiping out a competitor; others wonder if the diamond miners had taken action against the tariffs charged on river traffic.⁠

746707653:
Hyannis

Hyannis is an Ustalavic coal-mining settlement in the county of Versex; the forlorn shacks of the villagers are set on the edge of the Hungry Mountains near to the source of the Danver River.⁠⁠ The village and the mines are still haunted by the greenish spectre of the witch called Black Aggie, whom the villagers rose up against nearly forty years ago; they ripped the monster to pieces then burnt her before casting her remains into an abandoned mine. Worse than the hauntings, though, are the miners who become possessed by what is considered Black Aggie's suffocating breath.⁠

776765843:

778851673:
New Oppara

New Oppara (pronounced new oh-pa-ra)⁠ is the capital of the nation of Linvarre, formerly the Taldan colony of Amanandar, on the continent of Tian Xia. It was rechristened in 7108 IC (4608 AR) by its colonial founder, General Orphyrea Amanandar, who defeated the local warlords who had previously controlled it. Its original Tien name was Kamikobu⁠ (pronounced ka-mi-koh-bu).⁠

Positioned near the Ilushe River and bathed in its mists, New Oppara features architecture blended between Tian and Taldane styles. The city also includes the Raocado Market of hawkers and the Ocallio Institute of magical practice.⁠
782375323:
Table of Ralock

The Table of Ralock is a flat rock formation located on the plains south of Urgir, near the end of Flood Road. 833442893:
Lost Temple

Located in the southern reaches of the Katapesh desert near the border with Nex, the Lost Temple was clearly once a religious site, but no one knows which deity it was devoted to.

The ordered layout suggests that it was probably dedicated to a lawful god, but beyond that the evidence is confusing. The temple has small, individual cells that suggest it may have been a monastery of Irori. Beneath it is a huge vault reminiscent of those found in temples of Abadar, while the abandoned soaring towers look more like those dedicated to the sun goddess Sarenrae. There are even rumors that the temple may have been dedicated to the dead god Aroden, though there is no evidence of this.

The site often draws adventurers of a religious bent to the site determined to identify who it was dedicated to. This constant influx of armed adventurers has kept the site relatively free of the dangerous monsters that often use abandoned ruins as lairs.⁠

848750113:
Mount Sinatuk

Mount Sinatuk is a volcano at the far western end of the Five Kings Range,⁠ near the border of Druma and Isger.⁠ It is approximately two miles tall.⁠

While the surrounding lands contain large fragments of black volcanic rock as evidence of an ancient eruption,⁠ as of 4712 AR the volcano had not been geographically active during the recorded history of the dwarves of the Five Kings Mountains.⁠ The nearby independent dwarven Regulate of Grimsburrow had used the dormant volcano's geothermic properties to provide heat, light, and steam power, and discovered mineable diamonds deep within its vacant lava tubes.⁠
849458203:
Skarx's Prison

Skarx's Prison was used by the Council of Thieves in 4710 AR as a place to hold the most sensitive prisoners instead of placing them under house arrest, as was the practice elsewhere. A cambion named Skarx Veskandi ran the prison with a discipline and cruelty that rivaled that of a devil.⁠
856896343:
Mewru

Mewru (pronounced miu-ROO)⁠ is a city-state of outcasts, criminals, and scavengers of the underwater nation of Xidao, located in the Xidao Gulf of eastern Tian Xia.⁠⁠ It is located in Western Xidao, the part west of the Aya-Maru trench.⁠
864667253:
Moost

The hamlet of Moost grew up around the nearby Crabbe Estate and attends to the family's cranberry bogs but has also flourished into a small, almost self-sufficient little community (Moost still somewhat relies on the financial support of House Crabbe).⁠ Moost is also famous for hosting the largest and nicest coaching house along the North Cassomir Highway.

Dame Parthena Crabbe used to run a very successful conservatory tutoring young musicians and dancers at the nearby Crabbe Estate that bolstered Moost's economy but the number of students has dwindled since Parthena's husband passed away.⁠ Moost is awash with gossip, the most common being around possible suitors for the Crabbe heiress, Sepsinia Crabbe.⁠

Grand Lodge

The Grand Lodge is the world headquarters for the organization of explorers known as the Pathfinder Society. 945493893:
Bafra's Face

Bafra's Face is an ancient stone sculpture located on a stony hillside in the Verduran Province of Taldor. Its construction was ordered by Grand Prince Bafra, who ruled the empire in the late 1st millennium AR. The face was carved to depict Bafra overlooking the Tandak Plains, but as of 4717 AR it had become too heavily eroded to make out any of its details.⁠

As of 4717 AR, the statue was the site of a spriggan-led clan attempting to raise its own stone deity in order to stave off the Universe's horrors and return to the First World.⁠ The clan's leader is the spriggan oracle Ifgeiher, whose plan involves transforming Bafra's Face into a stone colossus, and his followers—which include gargoyles and other creatures—already worship the statue as a "rock god". A small clan of moss trolls have also occupied the site but does not participate in Ifgeiher's faith.⁠

Cutlass Cove

Cutlass Cove is located a quarter of a mile off the east coast of Rego Sacero on a small peninsula west of Westcrown. It is a resting place used by smugglers and pirates and has a few buildings near the shore.⁠
974728473:
Choking Tower

The Choking Tower, located in the Smokewood of south-central Numeria, was once the domicile of the technomancer Furkas Xoud, a former member of the Technic League.⁠⁠
981616183:
Kallow Mounds

The Kallow Mounds are the burial grounds of the Shoanti clan known as the Skoan-Quah, and are located on the Storval Plateau approximately 50 miles east of Kaer Maga.⁠
982099573:
Well of Lies

The so-called Well of Lies is a dungeon in the west of Nex. It is situated in a rift near the foothills of the Shattered Range. It is believed the complex was built by the cyclopes, who called it Golanoth, in an ancient age before the fall of the Starstone.⁠

The archmage Nex and his adventuring companions found clues to the dungeon's location amongst the ancient ruins of the Mwangi Expanse, and eventually located and explored the complex.⁠ It is believed that what Nex found there, contributed a great deal to his eventual rise to power.⁠⁠

There are strange scrying pools in the depths of the caverns, which purported to guide Nex in his search for eternal glory.⁠ It was the pools' whispering which convinced Nex to establish in the region the kingdom which bears his name. However, following their advice seemed to result in worse and worse outcomes, and eventually they came to be known as the Well of Lies.

The dungeon was sealed up on the orders of Nex. However, Nex disappeared a long time ago, and the Council of Three and Nine are lax in enforcing this edict. A few bold adventurers have been able to enter the dungeon in search of the pools' dangerous advice.⁠

Many of the mysterious Passages of Nex, who resemble Nex's deceased victims, migrate from the Well of Lies and across the nation of Nex claiming to speak on Nex's behalf.⁠
982225393:
Eran's Rest

Eran's Rest is a remote but picturesque settlement within the Hungry Mountains, perched on the eastern side of the Ghorcha Pass among the Hundred Haunted Vales and overlooking the Adghain Valley. It is located in the Ustalavic county of Amaans, and a steep goat path provides access to the village.

The village is dominated by herders and weavers but is also associated with fairy tales and other stories of badly-behaved fey. The villagers portray these tales in their art and architecture as well as their stories. Unfortunately, there may be more to the tales than mere story as the village suffers regular disappearances and other strange events.⁠⁠
989300463:
Desolation Blade Mounts

990135823:
Diobel

Diobel is one of the larger towns under the rule of the city-state of Absalom. While not as large as Escadar off the Isle of Kortos' northern coast, Diobel plays an important role in the commercial and political affairs of the City at the Center of the World.⁠
996819913:

Locals have a taboo about entering the Barrowmoor, believing that ancient curses will fall upon any trespassers. Some ignore such tales, lured by the prospect of discovering ancient, buried treasure. Those who return claim that the mounds cannot be accurately counted, and that new ones appear once every few years.⁠

1019695923:
Aaminiut

Aaminiut is the largest town in the decentralized Erutaki land of Hasanaliat. It is located on the southeastern end of Whitefang Bay at the mouth of the great Taraska River.⁠⁠ Built on stilts, Aaminiut covers numerous small islets in the river delta and the nearby Hazalin Marshes.⁠

Numerous Erutaki tribes are represented in Aaminiut, each tribe claiming its own islet or (for the smaller tribes) sharing an islet with a few other tribes.⁠ The largest clan in the city are the Miusunnit, whose claims in the city include control of the rare ice peppers found in the Hazalin Marshes.⁠ Many of the Erutaki migrate away from Aaminiut during the summer months, but most of the town's populace is permanent. A small colony of Ulfen traders from Almhult also lives in Aaminiut.⁠
1020884803:
Kukgukmol

Kukgukmol is a small village on the Cannibal Isles in the Shackles. Kukgukmol has been at war with the neighboring village of Heggapnod for years. The two villages rapidly lose men, and they will surely obliterate one another if nobody steps in to stop them. The Blood Queen enjoys this bloodshed and watches the weekly massacres through its kuru surrogates in each village.⁠

Andos Hall

1040692513:
Yin-Sichasi

The underground city of Yin-Sichasi beneath the Gossamer Mountains is home to the witch-queen Lady Lang Loi, who rules over the monster-dominated brigand nation of Shenmen in Tian Xia. Most people who live in Yin-Sichasi are the witch-queen's slaves.⁠

Many of the inhabitants are jorogumo, like the ruler herself, and on rare occasions will turn into undead known colloquially as "bone-fang jorogumo". These creatures occupy a half-ostracized, half-exalted position as occult advisors and spiritual intermediaries within the city.⁠
1045655153:
Tolsen Peak

Tolsen Peak is a mountain in the southwestern Menador Mountains of Cheliax east of Hellmouth Gulf.⁠
1047735653:
Antler Lodge

Antler Lodge is the temple of Erastil, located in the urban city of Absalom, offering respite in its gardens to those who long for a rustic life. In the Eastgate district, a modest two-story structure can be seen with aesthetically pleasing wooden atlers at the entrance. The walls are magically reinforced to block out outside noise, granting tranquility to those inside. Instead of windows, illusions of rural landscapes adorn the walls, and the lodge is maintained by High Priestess Loys Zepah, an elderly woman who feeds sweets and confectionery like a grandmother to her grandchildren. Lately, strange things have begun to appear in the illusions, such as sick animals or burning landscapes, and adventurers are being sought to investigate the cause of this phenomenon.⁠
1056005863:
Sturnidae

The town of Sturnidae is located in the south of the Ustalavic county of Barstoi, very close to the blasted wasteland known as the Furrows.⁠⁠ Its proximity to the Furrows is never forgotten as, when the wind blows aright, a pall of grey ash from the wasteland is blown over the town; it lands on the fields tainting the crops and the food with decay. Furthermore, locals report seeing visions of the war in the clouds of dust, such as marching peasant soldiers and charging knights.⁠
1060676093:
Edammera's Folly

Edammera's Folly is a tall spire locked behind large rune-scribed steel doors. It is one of the Towers of the Fiendlorn constructed to serve the experiments toward immortality by Mesandroth Fiendlorn, but was sealed after a planar rift to the Netherworld opened in its base in -398 AR and flooded the tower with creatures of shadow.⁠
1063000283:
Lake Platter

Lake Platter is the largest lake entirely inside Nirmathi borders. Cool all year long due to its mountainous sources, Lake Platter is five miles long but less than a mile wide. The lake boasts several fishing hamlets along its coast, and contains several bagiennik populations: amphibious newt-like fey with healing powers.⁠
1078836173:
Gold's Ruin

In 4713 AR, three nobles from Magnimar journeyed to Iron Harbor and paid the town a large sum of money for three plots of land to the west of Iron Harbor. These were the Mindurians, Valdemars, and the Vanderales, and they hoped to build a new settlement in the Ironbound Archipelago. Although construction began quickly the project was later abandoned after a devastating tsunami struck Magnimar, resulting in all three noble houses to instead prioritize protecting and repairing assets closer to home.⁠ Locals dislike the site they call Gold's Ruin' and consider it to be haunted.⁠ Yet not all have abandoned the ruins. The Valdemar manor currently serves as the abode of Derrol Finnick, an architect formerly of Magnimar who came to Iron Harbor with the Valdemars to help them in their project, but later abandoned his patron after a dispute about his pay. Unable to assimilate with the rest of the village, he has been able to build a somewhat happy life fishing and foraging for his necessities while living in the abandoned Valdemar estate.⁠
1086775943:
God's Market

This street in Absalom's Ascendant Court houses a market where many of the city's religions sell religious items such as religious symbols, water, texts, and clothing.⁠ Scrolls, potions, and other minor magic items, as well as the services of moneylenders and skilled craftsmen such as jewelers, are also available.⁠ Items such as the religious symbols of evil deities are sold on the black market, but not publicly available.⁠
1089725113:
Prismatic Lantern

The Prismatic Lantern is a monumental siege tower located on the Ustradi River near the city of Ecanus. It is equipped with magical weapons that, in times of war, target the Mana Wastes or Geb, unleashing multicolored beams of immensely powerful arcane energy. Designed by Archlord Alzika Karr, the tower became her tomb when she failed to predict that its energies could not be contained within the demiplane she had prepared. Even with her spectacular death, the clergy of Nethys continue to renew the wards each year, and the city's arcane college sends its graduates to witness its magnificence firsthand.⁠ The tower glows with magical energy constantly, and entry is only possible by flying, as those who cannot perform this basic form of magic do not deserve to experience the tower's wonders.⁠
1095698773:
Suketh'ma

Close to Vargas Swamp, where the desert gives away to the swamp, underground water channels turn the ground to mud in a patch known as Suketh'ma. A large patch of sand conceals countless quicksand pits interspersed with muddy ditches, and travelers frequently disappear forever in the sucking pits. The mire is home to many sand eels.⁠
1108901463:
Circle of Hierophants

The Circle of Hierophants is a circle of stone menhirs created in Old Sarkoris and located in the Stonewilds of modern Sarkoris. Druids of the Green Faith worshiped here, as this was the greatest of their stone circles.⁠

Hundreds of stones of varied sizes make up the many circles located at the site. Many of the circles has stones placed at exact angles beyond the known ability of man to build repeatedly. Each stone has rituals, legends, and secrets carved into them. Unlocking these carvings is beyond those who do not practice the Green Faith. Some of these circles are on small hills overlooking the main circle, giving the area a feeling of depth. Six of the circles are around cave mouths that reportedly led to deeper caves and even more stone circles. While leaders of the faith once protected these caves, after the opening of the Worldwound corrupted siabraes lived within.⁠
1116387653:
Bhula Prison

Bhula Prison, or Bhula Jail,⁠ is a prison located on an island off the southern coast of Vudra, in the most desolate reaches of its Falling Mountains region. The massive structure detains creatures and criminals who would profane the rest of Vudra's holy soil with their mere presence.⁠

Bhula is not the first prison built for this purpose, but all of its predecessors were shuttered or destroyed after their prisoners were afflicted with horrifying psychic maladies.⁠
1125171503:
Abalone House

Abalone House is a tenement in the Jarvis End neighborhood of Kintargo, Ravounel, that offers extended housing for traveling theater crews, many of whom stay for months during a running production.⁠
1136074953:
Sallix Salt Works

The Sallix Salt Works are the largest and oldest such business in all Kintargo and are located in the oldest part of the city, Old Kintargo.⁠⁠
1136399773:
Endiron School

The Endiron School in Eastgate is a school founded by a noble family with the aim of using words to resolve conflicts between people. To this end, the institution places great emphasis on languages, and its students must know two non-native languages ​​before graduating.⁠ Instructors from abroad come to share their culture, language, and food with the students, who often become merchants, diplomats, or travelers. The student body is composed of three-quarters Eastgate children who do not have to pay for their education, while the remaining third consists of children from abroad from families who have heard of the school's reputation and pay exorbitant tuition fees for their children to study there.⁠
1136702203:
Mithril Chef

The Mithril Chef is a high-end restaurant that also serves as a second-mark Firebrands cell located in The Docks district. All its staff are members of the organization, led by Claudette Butterfoot, who is more focused on cooking than going on adventures, though she frequently gives her employees "vacations", after which news of their deeds is heard around the city. The food they serve is excellent, very varied, and with strong aromas that make a good impression and one can also see the chefs using juggling techniques to prepare it, which always entertains the customers. They have a rivalry with the Bladed Bastards, although their fights are staged as a distraction until agents from both groups collaborate to free prisoners and help the population.⁠
1144239573:
Vaneo Arvanxi

Vaneo Arvanxi was a vast estate in the Rego Sacero of Westcrown that as of 4709 AR served as the home of Lord-Mayor Aberian Arvanxi, into which he had poured such immense wealth that it had earned the local nickname of Aberian's Folly.⁠
1156108573:
Absalom Lighthouse

Absalom Lighthouse is located on Pilot Island at the center of Absalom's Flotsam Graveyard. It is a famed piece of architecture built under the command of the god Aroden. At 655 feet in height, the light from its tower can be seen from as far as 50 miles away on a clear night and at least 25 miles on stormy evenings or bright afternoons. All Inner Sea navigators know its light, which has helped make the City at the Center of the World a successful trade port.⁠ Along with the Blue Tower, the Spire of Nex, and the peaks of the Kortos Mounts, it is among the most recognizable parts of Absalom's skyline.⁠
1170048483:
Caves of the Craven

The Caves of the Craven are an enormous network of damp caves and tunnels located beneath the Calphiak Mountains of western Varisia. The caves' main inhabitants are countless tribes of goblins who raid the nearby human communities of the Velashu River valley. The tunnels eventually lead down to Nar-Voth and provide the most direct route from the surface to the xulgath realm of Kuvhoshik. The goblins of the caves fear the xulgaths and generally keep out of their affairs.⁠⁠

The caves also have a connection to ancient history. They were the escape route for a group of elves from the nearby city of Celwynvian in the Mierani Forest, who chose to escape the imminent impact of the Starstone by fleeing deep underground in -5293 AR. Although this exodus saved them from the worst ravages of Earthfall, they encountered dangers in the Darklands they had never expected.⁠ One such access point to the caves is from the ruins of the Tower of the Ironwood Watch located on the Velashu Uplands.⁠
1172199363:
Abken

One of the newest settlements in Varisia, the village of Abken was founded in 4668 AR as a commune by peace-loving, lower-class Korvosans.⁠ It is located on the banks of the upper Yondabakari River (before it flows into Lake Syrantula), about 45 miles northeast of Melfesh.⁠ The town is surrounded by a wooden palisade, and is fiercely protected by its inhabitants.⁠
1172471873:
Terapasillion

Terapasillion (which means "Ziggurat of Night" in the Shadowtongue) is an ancient step pyramid eternally cloaked in shadows that predates Taldan settlement in the region, and is located on the southern North Plains of Ravounel near Nidal. It is rumored to have been built by shadow giants during the Age of Darkness, but was more recently inhabited by an umbral dragon. Despite the fact that the dragon has not been seen in decades, locals still avoid the place with a passion.⁠
1210940573:
Litran

Litran is a Galtan city best known for being the headquarters of the mysterious executioners known as the Gray Gardeners, and because of their intimidating presence, it was one of the most stable cities in the nation.⁠
1222549183:
Aelyosos

Aelyosos is the westernmost city of note in the archipelago of Iblydos in the Obari Ocean. It serves as the gateway to Iblydan culture and hospitality to most travelers on the Obari Crossing and, due to its many gardens and the tireless work of its citizens, is an overall peaceful place to rest and conduct trade.⁠
1240441583:
Maecho

Maecho is a city in Hwanggot, a nation in Tian Xia.⁠ In contrast to Haseong, Maecho is a slower-paced city, making it a relaxing destination. The city's many hot springs are its largest attraction.⁠

Sandpoint

Ronin's camp

The Ronin's camp is located among the uncultivated lands of northern Minkai and consists of palisades and tents used by ronin loyal to Hirabashi Jiro. Many of these ronin were samurai from Kasai who were exiled by the Jade Regent for refusing to acknowledge his leadership as sovereign of the nation.⁠

Ipeq

1262712743:
Impound Yard

The Impound Yard is a set of docks owned by Magnimar's city government. Abandoned ships are moved here before being auctioned after 90 days. The auctions can be quite a spectacle since the contents of the holds may not be examined prior to bidding. The city takes possession of the cargo of ships not sold after six months, then scuttles the ships in the Varisian Gulf.⁠
1265957693:
House of Ruin

The House of Ruin is a temple located on the border between Nex and Katapesh where jabali Surma dedicated her worship until she was defeated by followers of Sarenrae. In the past, a river flowed through the rocky valley, but without Surma's blessing, nature has vanished, and only the stone structure remains. In 4715 AR, some pathfinders ventured into the structure, defeating Surma, who had transformed into a div, and allowing Sinuhotep, who was trapped inside, to escape.⁠

Pangolais

1274662933:
Chapel of Shadow

The Chapel of Shadow is an abandoned temple of Nethys which the residents of The Puddles believe to be haunted, as they see figures moving in the darkness at night. The Onyx Alliance uses the location to reliably transition from Shadow Absalom to the Universe.⁠
1287358813:
Hessim, Newby, and Sage Paint Manufactory

1296389293:
Haven

Haven is a clouded island in the middle of Lake Ocota that contains the largest settlement of Kallijae elves. The fog that surrounds the island serves the Kallijae well, as they prefer highly defensible and hard-to-find areas to settle. Because of how hard it is for others to find, Haven serves as a place to retreat to and recuperate. The Kallijae sometimes call it Last Stand to reflect this.⁠
1303960653:
Broken Bastion

The Broken Bastion was a clock tower maintained by a mystical sect obsessed with time, but three centuries ago the structure and the temporal artifact it protected were destroyed by the dragon Maejeryx Steeleye. Since then, strange temporal anomalies have occurred in the area, attracting the curiosity of Fourth Spell Lord Muar Gauthfallow, who resides in the complex. The sect constructed many chambers sealed with anti-divination magic to store dangerous magical artifacts, and Muar is putting them to good use by storing the dangerous contraband he acquires in the course of his duties, intended for use against any external magical threat. There is only one chamber that was already sealed before his arrival, and whenever a temporal anomaly occurs, the lock keeping it closed moves. Muar considers it his responsibility to be in the area in case whatever emerges from the chamber proves dangerous.⁠
1310126703:
Haunted Crater Lakes

The Haunted Crater Lakes are a series of five bodies of water northwest of the town of Slipcove on Bag Island. They are believed to have been created following impacts from meteorites several hundred years ago. The entire area is believed to be haunted by ghosts from the asteroid-belt known as the Diaspora according to Amberose Ysilde, who lives in Rumbutter.⁠
1319750443:
Scarnetti Villa

Scarnetti Villa is a the residence of House Scarnetti, one of Magnimar's newest noble families.⁠
1323673763:
Daltus Academy

The Daltus Academy is a boarding school that occupies an entire block of the district where its campus, dormitories, and classrooms are located. Students at this academy are often involved in fights and are viewed unfavorably by the other residents of the district who tend to avoid them.⁠
1331245293:
Court of Endless Revelry

The Court of Endless Revelry is the largest congregation of satyrs in the Palakar region, and is the closest thing to a satyr court.⁠
1336287373:
Kyonin Embassy

The Kyonin Embassy is located in the Ivy District, a gathering place for artists and a haven for the free-spirited elves of the forest nation. The manor house is built in the Castrovel style, and a number of ambassadors are rotating through, pursuing the nation's goals in Absalom. Rumors suggest that Queen Telandia Edasseril will visit the city to discuss something with Wynsal Starborn in person.⁠
1350529653:
Skirgaard

Skirgaard was a frost giant village in the Mindspin Mountains whose leader, Skirkatla, raided the region centuries ago, both during her life and even after her death. The village sits at an elevation of 9,000 feet, resulting in permanently snow-covered terrain perfect for the giants who inhabit it.⁠

At the base of the mountain, the temperature allows for cultivation, and there are several plantations of potatoes, onions, and wheat, as well as grasses that are harvested to feed the village's mammoths. Several giants from Volstus's armies trained in the village after Skirkatla allied herself with him during his conquest of Avistan.⁠
1353773963:
Gems of Kalistrade

The Gems of Kalistrade are five towers surrounding the Everlasting Palace, each containing a piece of the nation's history. These can be viewed by travelers recognized by the prophets and their curator, Werden Luddrecht. Two of the towers are inaccessible, and their purpose is unknown.⁠

1374065733:
Heldren

The peasant village of Heldren is located in the Sophra Prefecture⁠ of southern Taldor, close to the Border Wood.⁠
1374384733:
Sojourner's Rest

Sojourner's Rest is a village in the southern Grungir Forest of the Lands of the Linnorm Kings, situated in the foundations of Thornwall Castle.⁠⁠
1375501823:
District Courthouse

The Westgate District Courthouse is a large, four-winged building where trials for the district are held and the prosecutor's offices are located. In the middle of the wings is a huge pool where, by tradition, suspects are brought to the edge to see their reflection in this natural mirror and clear their thoughts before entering court.⁠
1377452663:
Isle of the Dreamers

The Isle of the Dreamers is located in the eastern part of Lake Tapipallati, off the west-central coast of Xopatl. On this island the veil between the Universe and the Dreamlands is particularly thin, allowing easy access to people and for planar energy to seep through and transform local wildlife into alebrijes.⁠
1392607463:
Palace of the Brumal Lords

The frozen Palace of the Brumal Lords is where the three Brumal Lords are magically sealed, as they have been for the past 1,400 years. The three fey Baeloc, Nojec, and Yahlo were once allied with Baba Yaga, but after the Holvirgang Uprising they retreated here and refused any attempts at peace. So Queen Jadwiga used the Lock of Pajari to seal them within its walls.⁠

Gremlins are the only creatures that can still get in and out of the palace, and will sometimes raid nearby villages.⁠
1392807423:
River Runner Inn

The River Runner Inn is located in the Leeward District of Riddleport. It is a large structure, perched on a bluff overlooking the Velashu River. It is a somewhat pricey inn, but its true purpose is to serve as a clearing house for the smuggling and black market operations of crimelord Avery Slyeg.⁠
1394195193:
Seaside Betty's

Seaside Betty's is the smallest brothel in Ilizmagorti, consisting of a single room run by the elderly Seaside Betty. Clients seek the information she provides, as Betty knows the comings and goings of the city's crews and serves as their intelligence network; even the Red Mantis utilizes her services.⁠
1412246643:
Yelligo Wharf

Yelligo Wharf is a small pirate settlement on the island of Dahak's Tooth in the Shackles.⁠

The settlement was established in 4709 AR and hides itself in Leatherwing Bay. The ramshackle settlement consists of a few squat buildings made of driftwood and dirt clinging to the shore. It is home to four pirate crews that prey on the merchant ships travelling close to the mainland, east of Shenchu Bay. Kamshika Heavyhand captains the armored sloop Baleful Glare, Mean Steebyn captains the barkentine Rough Customer, Noila the Knife captains the brig Harm's Way, and Pendahl of Rahadoum captains the sloop-of-war Baalzebul.⁠

These four captains capture Inner Sea merchant vessels on their way home from Port Peril, stealing their cargoes and selling their crews to the cultists of Dahak for sacrifice. Chadric of Laekastel, who lives in the only stone building of the town, is the apparent head of the business.⁠
1429309003:
House of the Silken Veil

The House of the Silken Veil is a temple and bawdy house dedicated to the deity Calistria. It is located in the Leeward District of Riddleport.⁠⁠
1429359743:
Three Rings Tavern

1437496723:
Skull Hill

Skull Hill is a Chelaxian fort located in the southern reaches of the Hold of Belkzen in a region known as the Skittermounds.⁠

The fortification marks the furthest extent of the Everwar campaign and the conquest of Cheliax. The fort was used for mercenary recruitment and weapons trading. Skull Hill consists of a motte and bailey keep, surrounded by a wooden wall with a surrounding moat.⁠

Until recently, it was believed to have been destroyed not long after the events of the Everwar but, in fact, continued to be used as part of a spy network to monitor orc activities: an attempt by Cheliax to ensure the protection of its southern territories.⁠

The fortress was invaded and sacked in 4709 AR by a tribe of orcs known as the Skittering Ravagers who had been terrorising the region for years.⁠
1443748203:
Margruel's Masts

Margruel's Masts is a popular shipyard in The Docks, building cutters and caravels that serve a variety of purposes for both sailors and merchants.⁠
1446128313:
Spider nest

A 5-foot-wide and 25-foot-deep, densely webbed spider nest sits among the plant life of the Rostland Hinterlands, about a dozen miles southwest from Bokken's Hut. It is home to a spider as large as a pony, which hides the entrance of its lair with a trapdoor of hardened soil and waits for creatures to ambush. The nest's position is only given away by the skeletons of its prey, littering a 20-foot radius around the shaft hidden in their center. The scattered bones belong to deer, boars, bears, and humans.⁠

1480237253:
Silverhall

Silverhall is a city that is located on the Awzera River in Brevoy, just before the river empties into Lake Reykal.⁠ This town is the family seat of House Lebeda,⁠ and it was here that the Lebeda family kept the Horn of Aroden for many years.⁠
1494903183:
Solifugid Nest

Beneath the Lady's Lagoon lies the Solifugid Nest, a cavern filled with spores and fungi where these strange arachnids reside. A pillar in the center depicts a beautiful woman with a barely legible inscription; it is hollow inside and once contained the succubus Avalexi.⁠
1495170463:
Varisian Council

The Varisian Council is one of the three governing bodies (along with the Office of the Lord-Mayor and the Council of Ushers) of the Varisian city of Magnimar. It was created to help address the needs and concerns of the city's Varisian people; it has little power in the city otherwise.⁠⁠ It is headquartered among the colorful tents and wagons of Magnimar's Keystone neighborhood. As of 4712 AR, it was led by the elderly Remeria Callinova.⁠
1502046253:
Mystery of the Gate

The Mystery of the Gate is an impressive inn and tavern in the Leeward District of Riddleport. It is favored by sages and scholars who visit the city to study the Cyphergate, and also increasingly patronized by adventurers exploring Varisia and the lands beyond. Its walls are decorated by glyphs and diagrams of the ancient monument, and the inn hosts twice-a-week lectures from cyphermages of the Order of Cyphers.⁠
1502603603:
Demirah

Demirah is one of the numerous massive trading cities that dot the Qadiran region of the Plains of Paresh, but is often overshadowed by the capital of Katheer. It is located at the south-western limits of the Plains of Paresh along the banks of the Pashman River estuary as it reaches the Inner Sea.⁠⁠
1509429673:
Liferoot Stone

The Liferoot Stone is one of the aeon towers that Aroden placed around the Isle of Kortos.⁠ The tower was a 300-foot-tall mudbrick step pyramid with a flat 10-foot-wide top and four uneven tiers, though it is now partially collapsed.⁠⁠

The tower is located in the Swardlands on the Isle of Kortos, and is the southernmost of the towers, located near the town of Castinlee.⁠
1515842603:
Sumadhadra

Sumadhadra is a massive port city located on the easternmost tip of Vudra's Divine Garden region, where it meets the Embaral Ocean, and is the subcontinent's easternmost city. Sumadhadra is a prominent trade centre, particularly with the continent of Tian Xia, and is where most visitors from that continent first enter Vudra.⁠
1523702213:
Uralt's Walk

Uralt's Walk is a path that the priests of Aroden built alongside Aroden's Rise in Westcrown's Rego Sacero, so that pilgrims could take the path as a physical religious rite by climbing the hill without using the ramp. Each of the 166 steps has a word engraved on it, flanked by the Eyes of Aroden, forming Founder Uralt's Dawn Liturgy to Aroden that can be read while walking.⁠
1527456223:
Folarth

The town of Folarth is located in southern Nirmathas near the Deepcut River.⁠
1532637073:
Lifter's Mooring

Lifter's Mooring is a dockworkers' union led by Guyton Grerton, who is considered an idol and symbol of the city's workers. The union deals with businesses by offering contracts that meet the needs of their employers and ensuring the rights of their workers. Founded in 4715 AR, the vast majority of dockworkers belong to the union, and Grerton seeks to expand into other boroughs using his seat on the Docks Council.⁠
1552297133:
Sanctuary of Shelyn

The Sanctuary of Shelyn is the smallest independent temple in the city of Korvosa. Dedicated to Shelyn, the goddess of beauty and art, it also ranks as amongst Korvosa's most beautiful buildings. The sanctuary sits in the heart of the North Point district; it is a square building set around a central courtyard filled with beautiful statuary and murals, as well as an array of enticing plants. While the building itself is also replete with fine artwork, it never feels cluttered.⁠
1560264663:
Leftover's

Leftover's is the only inn in the East Shore neighborhood of the Varisian city of Korvosa. It offers a dozen rooms big enough for two people to sleep in as well as a large, comfortable common room and charges standard rates. The innkeeper, Portenus Gaskelinni, is an old soldier who lost an arm in a fight with a Shoanti; this tale is often told by the innkeeper and re-enacted fortnightly by Gaskelinni's Korvosan Guard comrades in the inn as entertainment for the inn's guests.⁠⁠
1580660613:
Bokken's Hut

Bokken's Hut is located within the Rostland Hinterlands region of the Stolen Lands, a few miles south of Brevoy's border. The hut functions as both the residence and potion shop of an eccentric alchemist named Bokken, housing a modest alchemical laboratory.⁠
1583856573:
Arboretum Arcanis

The Arboretum Arcanis once contained a wonderland of exotic fruit and blossoms from beyond Golarion. It was housed in a magical crystal dome in the Precipice Quarter in Absalom.⁠

The magic that protected and nurtured the flora was placed by Beldrin, but these wavered and collapsed when the earthquake of 4698 AR struck the district. The magical cloud that hovered overhead, designed to provide nutrient-rich rain, became corrupted. Now the purple-black cloud spills caustic gray and yellow rain on the plants below. The plants that once thrived either withered away or evolved into horrific versions of themselves, while new abominations of nature have since sprung into existence.⁠
1584685973:
Crypt of Angus Amberleg

The Crypt of Angus Amberleg is believed to be the resting place of not only the notorious and successful pirate, who ravaged the Inner Sea and plundered 100 ships, but also his treasure. It is located somewhere in the interior of Mediogalti Island and is arguably the most famous of the region's numerous pirate crypts.

According to legend, the crypt was built by slaves who became a permanent part of the construction by being buried alive once the work was finished. It is believed that their ghosts now guard the treasure along with the undead pirate himself.

The treasure is believed to include ancient artefacts and large jewels, some the size of an ogre's fist.⁠

Frozen Pines

The Frozen Pines is a nightmare glade in the Grungir Forest that even the forest's fey fear to visit. This frozen region consists of several dozen square miles of territory.⁠

Its pine trees have adapted to the frost, but nothing else grows here, including any of the forest's normal undergrowth. Frozen Pines is said to be under the control of the White Witches of Irrisen, but in truth it serves as the hunting grounds for powerful wendigos.⁠
1636532353:
Mount Branthlend

The tallest mountain in the Stolen Lands, Mount Branthlend rises from the landscape like a distinctively shaped monk's head. An incredible 5,400 feet tall, the mountain, also known as the Peak of Broken Promises, features a bare, knob-like pinnacle of white stone. The mountain grants its name to the range in which it is found: the Branthlend Mountains.⁠

The mythos of the mountain is dominated by tales of Noarra, the great love of the barbarian lord Targran, who shouted curses from the peak of the mountain after the barbarian warlord took another woman as his queen. In that moment a great storm of fire and stone encompassed the peak of the mountain, and Noarra was said to be transformed into a great black dragon, who then rampaged across eastern Numeria. This myth attracts many travellers from throughout the land, drawn to the peak to cry out their own curses and oaths of vengeance.⁠
1637900953:
Eyes of the Bronze Man

The Eyes of the Bronze Man are part of the Face of the Bronze Man, a bronze-plated monument to Pharaoh Djederet I (died -1653 AR) that is shaped in his likeness. It is located in southern Osirion's Brazen Peaks. Each of the eyes is an entrance to a played-out mine, one of tin and the other of copper, which legend tells were important to the development of bronzeworking in humanity's distant past.⁠
1651647733:
Rapier Bay

Rapier Bay is a rowdy small town on Motaku Isle in the Shackles. It is led by the pirate lord Maxevale Janis, captain of the galleon Motaku Maiden. Maxevale always supports Lady Tessa in the Pirate Council, earning the nickname "the Puppy", though no man dares to say it to his face.

Rapier Bay is not a busy harbor like Quent, but is used by pirates who do not want to draw much attention to themselves while sailing near the island. Rapier Bay is famous for one of its smithies, the Steel-Clad Giant, that makes some of the finest blades west of the Arch of Aroden.⁠
1664969713:
Graymoor

Graymoor is a relatively peaceful town in Sovereign's Reach, a region of Numeria known more for its history of war and technological horrors.⁠ Graymoor is one of the few places on Golarion where androids are welcomed and can live alongside the locals peaceably.⁠

Flowering Jasmine Monastery

1701525873:
Watchtower

The Watchtower is located at the eastern edge of the city, making it the tallest tower on Absalom, surpassing both the Blue Tower and the Pilot Island lighthouse. From this structure, the Cairnlands are monitored, and even the distant Immenwood can be seen. The tower serves as the Eagle Garrison's base of operations, planning its expeditions before setting out across the island. They are the eyes and ears of the First Guard, searching for smoke to report fires and concerned less with investigations or arrests than with threats beyond a few isolated individuals.⁠ There's a running joke among the recruits that the tower isn't just tall, but contains an even deeper dungeon. This isn't true, but the recruits find it amusing to pass on the joke, which the commanders don't take lightly. These might not be just rumors, as a recruit ended up digging in the ground looking for a supposed secret wine cellar, only to find tunnels they didn't want to explore because something was whistling to them in the dark, and they quickly sealed the hole after the incident was reported.⁠

Azad

The city of Azad is located on the northern shores of the Betul Sea in the Western Ghats region of Vudra.
